author: reek
body: Lightweight page compiler for the Codex Browser. Parses a subset of Codex syntax used in page definitions (let bindings, function application, literals, lists) and evaluates the page function to produce a WidgetNode tree.

author: reek
body: This replaces the full compiler pipeline for in-browser use. The full compiler cannot be embedded because its internal Codex chapter dependencies are part of the seed binary.
